title: Approved Retention Payoff — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
Approved retention payoff — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

The approved retention payoff is the required payoff amount on the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, set under HUD's due-and-payable payoff rule from the appraisal on the loan's maturity case.

**Required payoff amount by plan.** The required payoff amount is the statement balance for every Borrower Voluntary Payoff other than a retention payoff and for every HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff, and a retention payoff, the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, carries the approved retention payoff as its required payoff amount.

**Reissued terms.** Reissued terms other than an approved retention payoff and a short-sale approval replace every figure and restart the good-through period, and every reissue is issued on request or when a new appraisal or revised contract is recorded; an approved retention payoff reissued on the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure replaces only the required payoff amount and the appraised value basis and keeps the current statement's date, good-through date, statement balance and per diem.

**When the approval is set.** The approved retention payoff is not set until the payoff case carries an issued statement balance. A case that shows no issued statement balance has no approved retention payoff.

## Recording the approval

**Capability.** The tool approves the payoff amount on a borrower's payoff case for a loan that has been called due, replacing the case's required payoff amount and recording the appraised value it relies on. The case keeps its status, statement date, good-through date, statement balance and daily accrual; only the appraised value basis and the required payoff amount are replaced, and the statement request and maturity case named are quoted back. On success the case shows the approved required payoff amount, the figure the borrower is told will pay off the loan.

**How it is invoked.** `approve_appraisal_based_payoff_a02ac9a5` is an agent-side tool, unlocked by the agent and then called.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `payoff_case_id` | the reference number of the payoff case, as returned by the payoff case lookup |
| `payoff_request_id` | the reference number of the payoff statement request on file that this write answers, as returned by the payoff submission lookup |
| `maturity_case_id` | the reference number of the loan's maturity case whose appraisal the approval relies on, as returned by the maturity case lookup |
| `appraised_value_basis` | the as-is appraised value the approval relies on; USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `required_payoff_amount` | the approved amount that pays off the loan; USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation naming the payoff case, statement request and maturity case reference numbers, the appraised value basis and the approved required payoff amount (USD, 2 decimal places); the word "approved" shows the write completed. No other return or error is defined for this tool.
